album.title: A Century of Setar Music (An Anthology of Contemporary Performance Style)

just_intervals.note: measured octave minus 1200 ¢, register to register

progression.narrative: The performance opens on A4 and dwells most on A in Phrase 1. Phrase 2 (0:07.8) introduces E, F, Fs, G, centred on D. Phrase 3 (0:20.3) introduces C, centred on D. Phrase 4 (0:34.1) introduces A, centred on A. Phrase 7 (1:00.9) introduces Bk, centred on A. The line peaks at D5 (583.5 Hz) at 0:55.9. It closes on D3, not the tonic (A4 → A4 → A4 → A4 → D3 → D3).
